question: Which of the following festivals is associated with the state of Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Parba**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Parba** is a major festival celebrated in the state of Odisha.
 
• This festival is dedicated to the worship of the Earth Goddess and womanhood.
 
• It is a three-day-long festival marking the onset of the monsoon and the advent of the agricultural year.
 
• The first day is called **Pahili Raja**, the second day is **Mithuna Sankranti**, and the third day is **Bhu Daaha or Basi Raja**.
 
• During these days, women take a break from household work and enjoy various indoor and outdoor games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odisha, formerly known as Orissa, is an eastern Indian state on the Bay of Bengal known for its tribal cultures and many ancient Hindu temples.
 
• The state is also famous for its classical dance form, Odissi, and its distinct cuisine.
 
• Other important festivals celebrated in Odisha include **Durga Puja, Rath Yatra, and Makar Sankranti**.
 
• Odisha's capital, Bhubaneswar, is often referred to as the "Temple City" of India.
